@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+const mongoose=require("mongoose")
+const { required } = require("yargs")
+const { feedback } = require("../controller/request")
+const { name } = require("ci-info")
+const Feed_back_Schema=new mongoose.Schema({
+    user:{
+        type: mongoose.Schema.Types.ObjectId,
+          ref: 'user',
+          required: true,
+          unique: true
+    },
+    name:{
+        type:String
+    },
+    user_type:{
+        type:String,
+        required:true,
+        enum:{
+            values:['Donor','Recipient'],
+            message:'{VALUE} is invalid UserType'
+        }
+    },
+    rating:{
+        type:String,
+        required:true,
+    },
+    feedback:{
+        type:String,
+        required:true
+    }
+})
+module.exports=mongoose.model("feedback",Feed_back_Schema);
